title: Solgen to appeal SC ruling declaring 2024, 2025 budgets unconstitutional
summary: MANILA, Philippines —The Office of the Solicitor General will file a motion for reconsideration to the Supreme Court to challenge its declaration that the 2024 and 2025 budgets are unconstitutional.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Office of the Solicitor General will file a motion for reconsideration to the Supreme Court to challenge its declaration that the 2024 and 2025 budgets are unconstitutional. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said this in a Palace briefing. /apl
